notes.sowing: Start indoors 5 to 7 weeks before planting out, {cm:1} deep. Set plants out up to 3 weeks before your last frost. Heads form best as the weather cools, so a crop sown 12 to 14 weeks before your first fall frost is often the better one.
notes.care: Hot spells, around {c:30} by day and {c:25} at night, can stop heads forming or make them loose and bitter. Water deeply each week and mulch to keep the roots cool.
notes.harvest: Cut the main head while the buds are tight, before any yellow shows. Smaller side shoots follow for several more weeks.
